item.title: Sessions, Checkpoints & Rewind
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: A session is a JSONL file you can resume, branch and rewind. What each of those restores, what a resumed session quietly forgets, and the four categories of change that rewind cannot undo.
